title: Unable to set english as language [3.2.0-beta1]
symptom: In AAPS 3.2.0-beta1, setting English as the language results in a half-half hybrid of English and system language, affecting units and time format. Some screens still show system language despite English preference.
cause: The issue is related to the app's language handling when the selected language differs from the system language, causing mixed language display.
fix: The issue was fixed by commits referenced by MilosKozak: commit 75d34955b7aba0782014631cd8656b7a67153186 and later commit 7faa34aa50d7deca20b344e23f6a136b30586501.
